issues.description: The Bitmap24 class has inconsistent types for the width attribute between template and solution. In the template header width is declared as short while in the solution header it is declared as int. Code that allocates and indexes the pixel buffer (new char[width*height*3], indexing by width*height) assumes width is an int-sized value; the differing declarations create a structural mismatch that can confuse students (which type to use) and may cause subtle bugs or portability issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24 member types consistent across template and solution. Prefer using int for width (and height) in the template header to match the solution and the usage in Bitmap24.cpp (e.g. change 'short width;' to 'int width;'). Ensure any related code and comments are updated accordingly so students see a single, consistent type to implement against.
